items.q: Well, this group that formed before was born into the jazz festival, the full -- the Harlem All-Stars. That was with Illinois Jacquet, Milt Buckner and people like that; the great little jazz, Roy Eldridge.

ctx.x: groups that were forming at this particular time?

Oh, yeah. Well, this group that formed before was born into the jazz festival, the full -- the Harlem All-Stars. That was with Illinois Jacquet, Milt Buckner and people like that; the great little jazz, Roy Eldridge. He's being held over now here in the -- in Foreign City at Jimmy Woods (sic) Ryan's, you know. And Jimmy Woods -- by the way, one of Roof Ellington's late brothers finds, he's a bassist. He lives over there in Paris. He was in the virtuso musicians we were with.
